title: Stepwise Reasoning Checkpoint Analysis: A Test Time Scaling Method to Enhance LLMs' Reasoning
venue: Proceedings of the 2025 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
authors_zh: Zezhong Wang、Xingshan Zeng、Weiwen Liu、Yufei Wang、Liangyou Li、Yasheng Wang、Lifeng Shang、Xin Jiang、Qun Liu、Kam-Fai Wong
paper_type_zh: 测试时扩展、过程奖励模型与推理搜索方法研究
best_for_zh: 研究 rollout 搜索、测试时计算、过程奖励模型、推理轨迹中间状态和可复现性审计的读者
one_line: SRCA probes a reasoning prefix with a temporary answer cue, uses checkpoint answers to diversify PRM-guided search and augment final candidates, but releases no code, traces, or replay ledger.
SRCA 在推理步骤间探测 checkpoint 答案，以其聚类维持 PRM 引导搜索的多样性并扩展最终候选；但没有公开代码、轨迹或可重放选择账本。
why: It gives the rollout-search track an explicit intermediate-state object and selection contract, while showing that test-time accuracy cannot establish checkpoint-label quality, PRM calibration, or reproducibility.
inclusion_reason: A concrete test-time search recipe that turns normally discarded intermediate reasoning states into answer-conditioned diversity signals and PRM-scored final candidates, while making the dependence on step formatting and process-reward behavior auditable.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The primary source is the EMNLP 2025 main-conference paper, pp. 17135–17148 (ACL Anthology 2025.emnlp-main.866; arXiv:2505.17829v1). SRCA asks a specific test-time-search question: when a model has already spent compute producing intermediate reasoning prefixes, can those prefixes expose useful answer hypotheses rather than being discarded as soon as a beam changes or terminates?

The paper identifies two linked problems in PRM-guided search. First, selecting only locally high-scoring continuations can make different branches converge on the same answer or reasoning direction. Second, conventional tree search typically returns only a few completed paths, even though an intermediate prefix may already support a correct answer before later reasoning degrades. The proposed object is therefore not a released training dataset: it is an online, per-prompt search record consisting of a step-delimited prefix, a temporary checkpoint completion, PRM scores, answer-cluster membership, selected beams, and optionally a reconstructed candidate ending at that checkpoint.

The reported evaluation surface comprises GSM8K, MATH500, AIME1, and the English mathematical no-image subset of OlympiadBench. This belongs in rollout_search_test_time_trace_data because it specifies how a rollout tree is expanded, scored, retained, and converted into a final answer at inference time. It is not evidence for a new process-supervision corpus or a policy-training recipe: no SRCA code, data, trace archive, or record-level manifest was verified. (Paper §1, §3, §4.1, Appendix A.1.)

主要来源是 EMNLP 2025 主会论文，第 17135–17148 页（ACL Anthology 2025.emnlp-main.866；arXiv:2505.17829v1）。SRCA 提出一个具体的测试时搜索问题：模型已经花费计算量生成中间推理前缀时，能否从这些前缀中暴露有用的答案假设，而不是在 beam 改变或终止后立即丢弃它们？

论文指出 PRM 引导搜索的两个相连问题。第一，只选择局部高分 continuation 会使不同分支向同一答案或推理方向收敛。第二，传统 tree search 往往只返回少量完成路径，即使某个中间前缀已能支持正确答案，而后续推理反而可能退化。因而其对象不是公开训练数据集，而是一条在线、逐 prompt 的搜索记录：带步骤分隔的前缀、临时 checkpoint completion、PRM 分数、答案簇成员关系、被选 beam，以及可选的以该 checkpoint 结束的重构候选。

报告的评测面包括 GSM8K、MATH500、AIME1，以及 OlympiadBench 中英文数学、无图像的子集。它属于 rollout_search_test_time_trace_data，因为它规定了 rollout tree 在推理时如何扩展、打分、保留并变成最终答案。它不是新的过程监督语料或 policy-training recipe 的证据：未核验到 SRCA 代码、数据、轨迹归档或逐记录清单。（论文 §1、§3、§4.1、附录 A.1。）

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
SRCA turns an intermediate prefix into an answer probe without permanently altering the continuing chain. On a detected delimiter such as ### Step, it saves the generation state, appends the fixed cue So, the answer is , records the immediate answer, then restores the original position and KV cache. This is Checkpoint Injection; the answer is a model prediction conditional on the prefix, not an external correctness label. (Paper §3.1.)

Answer-Clustered Search (ACS) uses that probe as a diversity key. At each step it samples N paths, asks a PRM for each path score, groups paths whose checkpoint answers are equal, sums scores within each group, and round-robins the best path from high-scoring groups until M beams survive. Checkpoint Candidate Augmentation (CCA) uses the same probe differently: concatenate the prefix, cue, and checkpoint answer into a complete candidate, score it alongside completed natural paths, and return the highest-PRM candidate. (Paper §3.2–§3.3; Algorithm 1.)

The feedback contract is mixed. PRM scores guide path survival and final choice; benchmark answers determine reported accuracy after the run. The PRM does not observe a gold answer during search, and a checkpoint answer is neither a verified proof step nor a generally calibrated reward. The closest comparisons are PRM-guided beam search, DVTS, Best-of-N, and weighted Best-of-N. SRCA changes the grouping key from path/tree structure or final answer frequency to an answer predicted from each intermediate prefix, then lets that prediction enter the final candidate pool.

SRCA 把中间前缀变成答案探针，同时不永久改变继续生成的链条。在检测到如 ### Step 的分隔符时，它保存生成状态，追加固定 cue So, the answer is ，记录即时答案，再恢复原位置和 KV cache。这是 Checkpoint Injection；该答案是以此前缀为条件的模型预测，不是外部正确性标签。（论文 §3.1。）

Answer-Clustered Search（ACS）把该探针当作多样性键。每一步它采样 N 条路径，用 PRM 得到每条路径的分数，将 checkpoint 答案相等的路径分组，在每组内求分数和，再从高分组中轮转选择最佳路径，直至保留 M 条 beam。Checkpoint Candidate Augmentation（CCA）对同一探针作另一种使用：把前缀、cue 和 checkpoint 答案串接成完整候选，与自然完成路径一起打分，返回 PRM 分数最高者。（论文 §3.2–§3.3；算法 1。）

反馈契约是混合的。PRM 分数引导路径存活和最终选择；benchmark 答案只在运行后决定报告的 accuracy。PRM 在搜索中看不到 gold answer，checkpoint 答案也不是经过验证的证明步骤或普遍校准的 reward。最接近的比较对象是 PRM 引导的 beam search、DVTS、Best-of-N 和 weighted Best-of-N。SRCA 把分组键从路径/tree 结构或最终答案频率变为各中间前缀预测的答案，并让该预测进入最终候选池。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs and checkpoint operation. A benchmark prompt is rendered with a system template that requests ## Step formatting for complex questions. The policy detects a delimiter, uses the existing prefix to decode one checkpoint answer after So, the answer is , records it, and rolls the state back. Main experiments use Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct; Appendix B.3 additionally tests Qwen3-0.6B. The paper does not disclose code, seeds, parser rules, stop tokens, or a durable serialization of the saved state. (Paper §3.1, §4.1, Appendix A.3.)

Search and reward. At the first step sample N paths; at later steps, each of M survivors samples N/M children. For each current path, obtain its checkpoint answer and PRM score. Equal answers form a cluster; cluster score is the sum of member path scores. Sort clusters by that sum, select the highest path in each cluster round-robin until M paths remain, then continue. The main path score is the score at the final reasoning step. DeepSeek's Llama3.1-8B-PRM-Deepseek-Data is used as the probability of +; Skywork-o1-Open-PRM-Qwen-2.5-7B contributes its last-token 0–1 value-head score. (Paper §3.2, §4.1, Appendix A.4.)

Candidate augmentation and budgets. For every checkpoint, CCA makes prefix + cue + checkpoint answer, scores it with the PRM together with completed paths, and returns the highest score. Sampling uses temperature 0.8, top-p 0.9, N in {16, 32, 64, 128}, and M=4 for selector methods. Early stopping halts when a checkpoint score exceeds tau; tau=1 means no early stop. This is a training-free test-time method. Reproducing it requires exact policy/PRM revisions, prompt/normalization rules, PRM formatting, checkpoints, scores, clustering decisions, benchmark IDs, hardware and runtime—not just the paper's hyperparameters.

输入与 checkpoint 操作。 benchmark prompt 通过 system template 渲染；对复杂题它要求 ## Step 格式。policy 检测到分隔符后，以已有前缀在 So, the answer is 后解码一个 checkpoint 答案，记录它，再回滚状态。主实验使用 Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct；附录 B.3 还测试 Qwen3-0.6B。论文没有披露代码、seed、parser 规则、stop token 或保存状态的持久化序列化。（论文 §3.1、§4.1、附录 A.3。）

搜索与 reward。 首步采样 N 条路径；后续每步由 M 条存活路径各采样 N/M 个子路径。对每条当前路径得到 checkpoint 答案和 PRM 分数。相等答案形成一个簇；簇分数是成员路径分数之和。按该和排序簇，从每簇的最高路径轮转选择，直到保留 M 条路径，再继续。主实验的路径分数是最后一个推理步骤的分数。DeepSeek 的 Llama3.1-8B-PRM-Deepseek-Data 取输出 + 的概率；Skywork-o1-Open-PRM-Qwen-2.5-7B 取最后 token 的 0–1 value-head 分数。（论文 §3.2、§4.1、附录 A.4。）

候选扩展与预算。 对每个 checkpoint，CCA 构造 前缀 + cue + checkpoint 答案，与完成路径一同交给 PRM 打分，返回最高分。采样使用 temperature 0.8、top-p 0.9、N∈{16, 32, 64, 128}；选择器方法 M=4。早停在 checkpoint 分数超过 tau 时停止；tau=1 表示不早停。这是 training-free 的测试时方法。复现需要精确的 policy/PRM revision、prompt/normalization 规则、PRM 格式、checkpoint、分数、聚类决策、benchmark ID、硬件和运行时，而不能只依赖论文超参数。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Under N=128 and M=4, Table 1 reports Llama-3.2-1B with the DeepSeek PRM at 85.60% GSM8K, 53.40% MATH500, 24.97% AIME, and 20.74% OlympiadBench for SRCA; the corresponding DVTS figures are 83.47%, 52.60%, 20.68%, and 19.40%. With the Skywork PRM, SRCA reports 85.97%, 65.20%, 39.71%, and 27.75%, versus DVTS 84.00%, 64.80%, 29.03%, and 25.82%. These are author-reported end-to-end accuracies for a fixed policy/PRM/scaffold, not isolated estimates of checkpoint quality. (Paper Table 1.)

The scale evidence is conditional on the same search setting. With DeepSeek PRM on MATH500, SRCA is reported at 51.2% with N=16 while DVTS is 49.8% with N=64. On AIME with Skywork PRM, SRCA at N=16 is 32.48%, above the best reported N=128 baseline, DVTS at 29.03%. The paper observes diminishing returns as N increases. It does not provide raw trials, uncertainty intervals, seeds, or a released trace ledger. (Paper §4.2.2, Fig. 2.)

For mechanism evidence, CCA is reported to account for about a 10% pass-rate improvement in the paper's ablation, and 19.07% of final answers originate from its expanded pool; checkpoint-answer rate ranges from 11.63% on GSM8K to 25.04% on OlympiadBench. Replacing ACS with a random cluster baseline at N=128/Skywork gives 83.78%, 65.00%, 28.62%, and 25.96%, below SRCA on the four datasets. At tau=0.95, early stopping reduces average reasoning steps by 27% while losing 0.58% accuracy in the stated experiment; low tau=0.5 loses 14% accuracy on MATH500. (Paper §5.2–§5.3, Table 3, Figs. 4–5.)

在 N=128、M=4 下，表 1 报告 Llama-3.2-1B 配合 DeepSeek PRM 时，SRCA 在 GSM8K、MATH500、AIME、OlympiadBench 上分别为 85.60%、53.40%、24.97%、20.74%；相应 DVTS 为 83.47%、52.60%、20.68%、19.40%。使用 Skywork PRM 时，SRCA 分别为 85.97%、65.20%、39.71%、27.75%，DVTS 为 84.00%、64.80%、29.03%、25.82%。这些是固定 policy/PRM/scaffold 下作者报告的端到端 accuracy，不是 checkpoint 质量的孤立估计。（论文表 1。）

扩展证据也以相同搜索设置为条件。在 DeepSeek PRM 的 MATH500 上，SRCA 在 N=16 时报告 51.2%，DVTS 在 N=64 时为 49.8%。在 Skywork PRM 的 AIME 上，SRCA 在 N=16 时为 32.48%，高于报告的最佳 N=128 baseline，即 DVTS 的 29.03%。论文观察到 N 增大时收益递减。它没有提供原始 trial、不确定性区间、seed 或公开轨迹账本。（论文 §4.2.2、图 2。）

对机制的证据是：论文的 ablation 报告 CCA 对 pass rate 约有 10% 改进，19.07% 的最终答案来自其扩展候选池；checkpoint-answer rate 从 GSM8K 的 11.63% 到 OlympiadBench 的 25.04%。在 N=128/Skywork 下，用随机簇 baseline 替换 ACS 得到四个数据集上 83.78%、65.00%、28.62%、25.96%，低于 SRCA。在所述实验中，tau=0.95 的早停将平均推理步数减少 27%，accuracy 仅减少 0.58%；低 tau=0.5 在 MATH500 上损失 14% accuracy。（论文 §5.2–§5.3、表 3、图 4–5。）

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Beam search and DVTS already use a PRM to decide which paths to extend; Best-of-N and weighted Best-of-N already use scores to select completed answers. SRCA's specific change is to query an answer from every intermediate prefix, then reuse that answer twice. ACS uses it as a path-clustering key, and CCA uses it as a candidate endpoint. This makes the selected object's provenance more explicit than a final-answer-only selector: a final choice can originate from an incomplete prefix plus a temporary answer completion.

What is not new is equally important. The work does not introduce a new policy, a new PRM, benchmark data, an external verifier, or a training procedure. It reconfigures known autoregressive search ingredients—sampling, beam retention, PRM scoring, and final selection—at test time. Its claimed fault tolerance is conditional: an early checkpoint is useful only if its answer is correct enough and the PRM ranks the reconstructed candidate above later but worse continuations.

For the rollout-search track, the direction signal is the record design: preserve checkpoint probes and their selection lineage instead of retaining only final paths. Before reuse, inspect delimiter coverage, checkpoint-answer normalization, state rollback, PRM version/format/calibration, equality clustering, and whether gold benchmarks overlap the policy or PRM training sources. None of those records are officially released here, so SRCA is a paper-level recipe and audit reference rather than a ready-to-run data artifact.

Beam search 和 DVTS 已使用 PRM 决定延展哪些路径；Best-of-N 和 weighted Best-of-N 已使用分数选择完成答案。SRCA 的具体改变是从每个中间前缀查询一个答案，然后两次复用它：ACS 将其作为路径聚类键，CCA 将其作为候选终点。这让被选对象的来源更明确，而不只是最终答案选择器：最终选择可能来自不完整前缀加临时答案 completion。

同样重要的是哪些并不新。该工作没有引入新 policy、新 PRM、benchmark 数据、外部 verifier 或训练过程。它在测试时重新配置已知的 autoregressive search 组件——采样、beam 保留、PRM 打分和最终选择。其声称的 fault tolerance 有条件：只有早期 checkpoint 的答案足够正确，且 PRM 将其重构候选排在后续但更差的 continuation 之前时才有效。

对 rollout-search track 而言，方向信号是记录设计：保存 checkpoint probe 及其选择 lineage，而不是只保留最终路径。复用前应检查分隔符覆盖、checkpoint-answer normalization、状态回滚、PRM version/format/calibration、相等性聚类，以及 gold benchmark 是否与 policy 或 PRM 训练源重叠。这些记录在此均未官方发布，因此 SRCA 是论文层面的 recipe 和审计参考，而非可直接运行的数据 artifact。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The paper states two direct limitations. Precise step boundaries are difficult: Llama-style ### Step structure is clearer than the conversational or unstructured output of some slow-thinking models. And CCA candidates often end with an incomplete reasoning path; they may still produce a correct answer, but are less interpretable and transparent than naturally completed chains. (Paper Limitations.)

The feedback layer adds further audit risks. PRM scores decide both which answer clusters survive and which truncated candidate wins. A PRM can be miscalibrated, sensitive to dialogue formatting, or favor a fluent but wrong endpoint. Using the last step score makes the PRM behave more like an outcome score; Appendix B.2 itself notes that correct paths may have imperfect intermediate reasoning. Exact equality clustering can also be brittle across equivalent numeric/expression formats. These are evidence-grounded curator inferences from the disclosed mechanism, not a measured SRCA error rate.

Reproduction and reuse remain limited. No official implementation, run configuration, checkpoint/cluster/score trace, raw result, model revision pin, or benchmark item manifest was verified. It is therefore impossible to independently check KV rollback, count checkpoint candidates, reproduce early stopping, inspect failed branches, or audit benchmark/PRM contamination from the public paper alone. Reported benchmark accuracy must not be used as proof that intermediate completions are safe process labels or suitable training data.

论文直接说明两项限制。精确定义步骤边界很困难：Llama 风格的 ### Step 结构比某些 slow-thinking 模型的对话式或无结构输出更清晰。并且 CCA 候选常以不完整推理路径结束；它们仍可能给出正确答案，但比自然完成的链条更缺乏可解释性和透明度。（论文 Limitations。）

反馈层还带来审计风险。PRM 分数同时决定哪些答案簇存活、哪个截断候选获胜。PRM 可能未校准、对 dialogue formatting 敏感，或偏爱流畅但错误的终点。使用最后一步分数会让 PRM 更接近 outcome score；附录 B.2 本身指出，正确路径可能有不完美的中间推理。精确相等聚类也可能在等价数值/表达式格式间失效。这些是由已披露机制得出的、以证据为基础的 curator inference，并非测得的 SRCA 错误率。

复现与复用仍受限。未核验到官方实现、运行配置、checkpoint/cluster/score 轨迹、原始结果、模型 revision 固定或 benchmark item 清单。因此仅凭公开论文无法独立检查 KV rollback、统计 checkpoint 候选、复现早停、检查失败分支，或审计 benchmark/PRM contamination。报告的 benchmark accuracy 不能作为中间 completion 是安全过程标签或适合训练数据的证据。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For rollout_search_test_time_trace_data, SRCA is useful as a specification for an auditable intermediate-state log. A reproduction should emit a stable prompt ID, policy and PRM revision, generation prefix, delimiter position, checkpoint cue, completion, normalized answer key, path score sequence, cluster aggregate, selection order, reconstructed candidate, terminal score, stop decision, and gold evaluation result in separate fields. Saving discarded branches is essential for diagnosing selection bias rather than only celebrating the final choice.

It also supplies controlled test-time experiments. Compare ordinary beam/DVTS, ACS without CCA, CCA added to baseline searches, and a random-cluster control under equal N, M, PRM, prompt, and token/latency budgets. Evaluate answer accuracy, pass@k/answer-discovery, checkpoint-origin rate, cluster diversity, PRM calibration, truncation rate, and early-stop regret separately. SRCA's reported curves motivate these measurements; they do not dictate a general budget or threshold.

Reuse class: reading/audit reference and implementation recipe only; direct training reuse blocked pending release and verification. The paper can guide a new independently logged implementation, but it does not release a trace corpus, training objective, license, or sufficient provenance to support SFT, PRM training, or reward-model claims. Treat its PRMs as external evaluated components, not as verified labels attached to an available dataset.

对 rollout_search_test_time_trace_data 而言，SRCA 可作为可审计中间状态日志的规范。复现应把稳定 prompt ID、policy 与 PRM revision、生成前缀、分隔符位置、checkpoint cue、completion、归一化答案键、路径分数序列、簇聚合分数、选择顺序、重构候选、终止分数、停止决定和 gold 评测结果分字段记录。保存被丢弃的分支对于诊断选择偏差是必要的，而不应只展示最终选择。

它也提供受控的测试时实验。应在相同 N、M、PRM、prompt 以及 token/latency 预算下，比较普通 beam/DVTS、无 CCA 的 ACS、向 baseline search 加 CCA，以及随机簇对照。分别评估答案 accuracy、pass@k/答案发现、checkpoint 来源率、簇多样性、PRM calibration、截断率和早停 regret。SRCA 的报告曲线可以启发这些测量，但不规定通用预算或阈值。

复用等级：仅作阅读/审计参考和实现 recipe；直接训练复用 blocked pending release and verification。 论文可指导新的、独立记录的实现，但没有发布轨迹语料、训练目标、许可证或足以支持 SFT、PRM 训练或 reward-model 主张的来源信息。应将其 PRM 视为外部评测组件，而不是已附着在可用数据集上的已验证标签。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read §3.1 before treating a checkpoint as a reasoning step label: it is an answer completion elicited by an extra cue and then rolled back, not the model's unmodified next token.
  • Keep the three objects distinct: a continuing path, its temporary checkpoint completion, and the reconstructed prefix-plus-checkpoint candidate. Only the latter two expose a possible early answer endpoint.
  • Table 1 is a policy-plus-PRM-plus-search result. The different DeepSeek and Skywork PRM rows show that verifier choice is a major confound, not an implementation detail.
  • Read Table 3/Figure 5 alongside Table 2: CCA can recover an answer before a later reasoning error, but it can also preserve incomplete explanations. This is fault tolerance for answer selection, not proof repair.
  • Before adopting the method, obtain code and logs for delimiter detection, KV restoration, exact answer normalization, PRM formatting, cluster ties, seeds, and benchmark item IDs. The paper does not provide them.

• 在把 checkpoint 当作推理步骤标签前先读 §3.1：它是由额外 cue 诱发、随后回滚的答案 completion，而不是模型未经修改的下一个 token。
  • 必须区分三个对象：持续的路径、它的临时 checkpoint completion，以及重构的“前缀加 checkpoint”候选。只有后两个暴露可能的早期答案终点。
  • 表 1 是 policy、PRM 与 search 共同的结果。DeepSeek 和 Skywork PRM 两行的差异说明 verifier 选择是主要混杂因素，不是实现细节。
  • 将表 3/图 5 与表 2 一起阅读：CCA 可以在后续推理错误前恢复答案，但也会保留不完整解释。这是对答案选择的 fault tolerance，而不是证明修复。
  • 采用方法前应取得分隔符检测、KV 恢复、精确答案 normalization、PRM formatting、簇 tie、seed 和 benchmark item ID 的代码与日志；论文未提供它们。

value.html: Evaluation prompts come from GSM8K, MATH500, AIME1, and the English, mathematical, no-image subset of OlympiadBench. SRCA does not release a new prompt or trace manifest; the paper describes 8,500 GSM8K items, 500 MATH500 questions, 933 AIME1 problems, and 674 evaluated OlympiadBench questions.

At a detected reasoning-step boundary, the current prefix is paired with the fixed cue "So, the answer is " and the immediate continuation is recorded as a checkpoint answer. Candidate records in the described method include a reasoning prefix/path, checkpoint answer, step-level PRM score, cluster membership/aggregate score, reconstructed prefix-plus-answer candidate, and final selected candidate; the precise serialization is unknown.

The evaluated policy model generates step-delimited reasoning paths and checkpoint completions at test time: Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct in main experiments and Qwen3-0.6B in an additional experiment. No public trace release was verified.

Training-free autoregressive tree search with policy KV-cache rollback, a process reward model, sampling budget N, beam width M, and optional threshold-based early stopping. It is not an external tool environment and has no released environment image, source repository, or reset manifest.

Two external PRMs are used: Llama3.1-8B-PRM-Deepseek-Data, scored as the probability of "+" after dialogue formatting, and Skywork-o1-Open-PRM-Qwen-2.5-7B, whose last-token 0–1 value-head score is used. PRM scores select paths/clusters and score reconstructed candidates; gold benchmark correctness is only used for evaluation, not the online selector.

Among complete natural paths and checkpoint-augmented prefix-plus-answer candidates, return the candidate with highest PRM score. With early stopping, stop when a checkpoint answer score exceeds threshold tau; this is a search-stop rule, not a proof of answer correctness.
Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct is the main policy; Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct is an independent-sampling comparison; Qwen3-0.6B is used in Appendix B.3. The paper does not train a new policy.

The policy LLM generates N step-delimited paths and immediate checkpoint completions. Checkpoint Injection saves the generation state, appends the answer cue, records the answer, and restores the original state/KV cache.

Sampling methods use temperature 0.8 and top_p 0.9. The paper varies N over 16, 32, 64, and 128; the main Table 1 setting uses N=128 and M=4. At later steps each of M survivors generates N/M subpaths. Random seeds, decoding implementation, stop-token handling, and released run manifests are unknown.
Per prompt, the search budget N is 16–128 sampled paths at each step; no aggregate number of prompts, checkpoint completions, paths, or retained candidates is released by SRCA.

Answer-Clustered Search groups paths with identical checkpoint answers, sums PRM path scores within each cluster, sorts clusters, and selects top-scored paths round-robin across clusters until M beams survive. Candidate augmentation keeps all checkpoint completions as PRM-scored endpoints. Exact answer normalization and implementation details beyond equality in the algorithm are not disclosed.

top_p=0.9; N=16, 32, 64, or 128; M=4 for path-selection methods. Early stopping tests tau from 0.5 to 1.0, with tau=1 meaning no early stop. Appendix cost analysis assumes 256 input tokens and 4,096 output tokens.
Training-free PRM-guided search; no optimizer. ACS uses PRM-scored answer clusters and CCA rescoring of reconstructed candidates. Path score in main experiments is the last step's PRM score.

Four public math evaluation sources and policy-generated test-time reasoning/checkpoint completions. The exact item versions, prompts, formatting exclusions, and per-run sample/trace composition are not released as an SRCA manifest.

SRCA reports evaluation across GSM8K, MATH500, AIME1, and a 674-question OlympiadBench subset. It defines no train/dev/test split or new dataset split, and does not release the precise item IDs or evaluation prompts used.
SRCA evaluates on public benchmark items, but no released checkpoint/trace manifest enables an audit of overlap with PRM training data, policy training data, or other evaluation suites.
The paper does not report policy-pretraining, PRM-training, benchmark, prompt-template, or test-time trace overlap controls. The use of public math benchmarks makes such exposure a material unknown.
The method conceptually generates discarded and surviving paths, but no complete log shows which branches, checkpoint candidates, PRM failures, or early-stop decisions were retained or dropped.

items: Step delimiters may not coincide with semantic reasoning units and may be absent in conversational or slow-thinking output formats.
Checkpoint-augmented candidates can be incomplete, reducing explanation quality and transparency; this is an author-stated limitation.
PRM error, calibration, formatting sensitivity, and last-step aggregation can change path survival and final selection.
Exact-answer clustering can split equivalent forms or merge superficial matches; answer normalization is not specified in the released paper algorithm.
The inserted answer cue and KV rollback are implementation-sensitive, and no code/trace release permits independent verification of state restoration.
Accuracy gains on public benchmarks do not validate every checkpoint as a correct process label or establish decontamination.
